title: Data source research candidate
description: One record per candidate data source evaluated by the research-sources skill. Written to research/candidates/<slug>.json.

url.description: Primary documentation or landing page URL.

granularity.description: e.g. tract, ZCTA, county, CBSA, national, point.

history_available.description: How far back usable history goes.

correlation_evaluated.description: Whether app/research/evaluate_series.py was run against this candidate.

correlation_results.description: Correlation/lead-lag numbers vs FHFA HPI / Zillow ZORI, if computed.

fills_gap.description: What existing adapter/pillar/field this would improve or replace.
